text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for training!
Let's give it our all today too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hm? I thought I saw something move just now—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-Where did you come in from!?
Please leave the room immediately, please!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, it's not moving...?
Could it be a spider toy?
I'm not scared of that, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah!! It twitched!
It really is a real spider! No waaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh... they're right by the door,
so I can't get outttt..."

Unable to leave her room for a while,
Matikanetannhauser ended up skipping training.
